segments.orig:
(zôt,) ithâ ât ýazamaidê ahurem
mazdãm ýê gãmcâ ashemcâ
dât apascâ dât urvaråscâ vanguhîsh
raocåscâ dât bûmîmcâ vîspâcâ
vohû ahyâ xshathrâcâ mazênâcâ
havapañghâishcâ.

têm at ýasnyanãm paurvatâtâ
ýazamaidê ýôi gêush hacâ
shyeiñtî.

têm at âhûiryâ nâmênî
mazdâ-varâ speñtôtêmâ ýazamaidê,
têm ahmâkâish azdibîshcâ ushtânâishcâ
ýazamaidê, têm ashâunãm fravashîsh
narãmcâ nâirinãmcâ ýazamaidê.
segments.en:
And we worship Him under His name as Lord, to Mazda dear,
the most beneficent (of names). We worship him with our bones,
and with our flesh, (with our bodies and our life). And we worship
the Fravashis of the saints, of holy men, and holy women; (4)
and Righteousness the Best do we worship, the most beauteous,
the Bountiful Immortal and that which is endowed with light in
all things good.
segments.zh: 我們以主之名敬拜他，為馬茲達所愛，最有益之名。我們用我們的骨骼與我們的肉敬拜他（用我們的身體與我們的生命）。我們敬拜聖徒的弗拉瓦希，聖者男與聖者女的弗拉瓦希；我們敬拜至善的正義，最美麗者，不朽聖者與被光所賦予一切良善事物之者。
segments.note: SBE 此處未另譯；本節原文與 Y 37.3 逐字相同，英譯與中譯代入該節。

segments.orig:
ashem at vahishtem ýazamaidê hyat sraêshtem
hyat speñtem ameshem hyat raocañghvat hyat vîspâ
vohû.

vohucâ manô ýazamaidê, vohucâ
xshathrem vanguhîmcâ daênãm vanguhîmcâ
fseratûm vanguhîmcâ ârmaitîm!

ýenghê hâtãm âat ýesnê
paitî vanghô mazdå ahurô vaêthâ
ashât hacâ ýånghãmcâ tãscâ
tåscâ ýazamaide!!
segments.en:
(To that one) of beings do we sacrifice whose superior (fidelity)
in the sacrifice Ahura Mazda knows through his Righteousness (within
him, yea, even to those female saints do we sacrifice) whose (superior
sanctity is thus known. We sacrifice to all) both males and females
whose (superiority is such).
(The Ratu speaks.) As an Ahu (revered and) to be chosen, he who is the Zaotar speaks
forth to me.
(The Zaotar.) So let the Ratu from his Righteousness, holy and learned, speak
forth!

segments.zh:
（對那樣的生靈）我們獻祭，其在獻祭中的卓越（忠誠）為阿胡拉‧馬茲達通過其內在的正義所知悉（是的，甚至對那些女聖人我們獻祭），其（卓越的聖性如此為人所知）。我們獻祭給所有（卓越性如此）的男性和女性。
（儀式主持者說）身為應被敬重和選擇的阿胡，身為祭司的他向我說話。
（祭司說）那麼願儀式主持者從其正義出發，聖潔而博學地向我說話！
